scope: One independent substantive review of fig-03, fig-04 and fig-05 only. Fig-06 is deferred because its current render is not ready.
procedure: Read the complete modern n2/n3/n4/n5 lesson templates. Opened each original source PNG and independently inventoried its pixels before inspecting FigureSpecs.

Compared the source inventories, authoritative prose, specs, existing render reports, current PNGs and actual SVG rasterizations. Used only existing local playwright-core/Chromium, with requests blocked; zero requests were made.
Ran the existing draft FigureSpec validator once for each reviewed figure. Viewed the complete actual images at 640, 331 and 342 px; also viewed fig-05 at its declared 400 px maximum.

independentSourceInventory: Three vertically stacked states of the same horizontal spring/ball/guide-rod system, each with two end supports and a left spring. Top ball lies on the common dashed vertical equilibrium line; middle ball is right of it; bottom ball is left of it.

One shared top horizontal axis, O at the equilibrium reference and X directed right. Middle state has a leftward force F, a double-ended amplitude interval and a ball-projection extension; bottom state has rightward F and a double-ended x interval.

No top-state force arrow, velocity arrows, numerical ticks or measured displacement data. Source panel letters are localized to a/b/c. The amplitude subscript glyph is not independently certified as a particular alphabet/case.

sourceFidelity.assessment: All three source states, rods, supports, spring connections, equilibrium reference, force directions and displacement endpoints are preserved. Shared-reference and b/c displacement assertions cover the points; semantic arrows have mapped connects assertions. Coil traces/support shading are explicitly schematic, not invented measured counts.

visualSemantics.assessment: Readably shows equilibrium, extension and compression with restoring force opposite displacement, consistent with n2 and n4. No force at equilibrium is drawn; no added velocity or numerical scale implies extra data. x_m is a semantic Latin localization matching modern prose, not an original-glyph finding. All labels and arrowheads remain distinguishable at 331/342 px; no clipping, cultural leakage or misleading additions observed.

independentSourceInventory: One apparatus: two separate stand bases and uprights; a long horizontal guide rod clamped at both supports; lower spring attachments on the uprights.
Central wheel/pulley and clamp at the guide, with a short vertical connector and one ball below; a left spring and right spring connect the ball assembly to opposing stands on one horizontal level.
No printed labels, force vectors, numerical scales or subfigure panels. Cast-base details and coil strokes are apparatus texture, not measured data.

sourceFidelity.assessment: Both stands/clamp levels, spanning guide, central wheel/clamp/connector, ball and two spring paths remain visible. The moving-alignment displacement and connector/spring assertions match the source assembly. Schematic bases and spring zigzags preserve function without inventing apparatus data.

visualSemantics.assessment: The guide, wheel/clamp, short support rod and two springs are distinguishable at 640/331/342 px and support n2's low-friction horizontal-motion explanation. No misleading force diagram, scale, cultural wording or added component. No clipping or overlap obscures the assembly.

independentSourceInventory: One upper suspension beam, a vertical spring and a single dark ball inside an open-top vessel with two sides and a bottom.
A solid liquid surface below the vessel rim; short horizontal liquid texture strokes. A separate full-width dashed horizontal line crosses the spring within the liquid, above the displayed ball.
No printed labels, force/motion arrows, second ball, numerical spring/damping values or scale. The prose identifies the dashed line as equilibrium.

sourceFidelity.assessment: Open vessel, immersion, suspension connection, single ball, solid liquid surface and distinct dashed equilibrium marker above the ball are retained. The ball-inside, vertical alignment and equilibrium-above-ball assertions match the independently inventoried relationships. No ghost equilibrium ball or inferred force diagram is introduced.

visualSemantics.assessment: Immersed ball and separate liquid/equilibrium levels remain unambiguous at 400/331/342 px and in the requested 640 px enlargement. Consistent with n2's conditional strong-damping model; the drawing makes no unconditional claim about every liquid or soft spring. No clipping, culture leakage, inferred values or misleading additions.
visualSemantics.previewComparison: Both the supplied current PNG and current SVG raster were actually inspected. A local decoded-pixel comparison at 400x640 found 712 differing pixels, bounds [77,255,322,609], maximum channel difference 56; no semantic difference was visually observed. Exact preview/SVG raster-byte or pixel identity is not claimed.
